# Jiaowen Yang (杨佼文)

> Research Scientist at Meta Superintelligence Labs, working on Data Governance & Privacy of LLM Training Data. PhD in Mathematics from the University of Southern California.

## Current role

- **Research Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs** (2019–Present)
  - Leading Data Governance and Privacy initiatives for LLM training
  - Tech Lead for Recommendation Systems in Virtual Reality
  - Delivered Meta's first production Generative Adversarial Network system

## Education

- **PhD, Mathematics — University of Southern California** (2015–2019)
  - Advisors: Shang-Hua Teng, Ting-Kam Leonard Wong
  - Research topics: Information Geometry, Optimal Transport, Generative Adversarial Networks
- **Visiting Researcher — École Polytechnique** (2014–2015)
- **BSc, Mathematics — Tsinghua University** (2010–2014)
  - New World Mathematics Gold Award

## Publications

- [GSI 2025] Maximum likelihood estimation for the λ-exponential family. With Xiwei Tian, Ting-Kam Leonard Wong, Jun Zhang. https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-032-03918-7_11
- [Information Geometry, 2021] Pseudo-Riemannian geometry encodes information geometry in optimal transport. With Ting-Kam Leonard Wong. https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s41884-021-00053-7
- [GSI 2019, Best Paper Award] Logarithmic divergences: geometry and interpretation of curvature. With Ting-Kam Leonard Wong. https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-26980-7_43
